label: Groovy field
title: When can the Groovy field run on its own? A full-line census
summary: Across all 256 elementary rules, 140 Groovy fields are local autonomous systems with one to four steps of memory; Rule 30 needs three. The Groovy field can never see the uniform D0 bit, and adding the source gradient with two steps closes every rule.
takeaway: What the Groovy field lacks is mostly background identity, including phase; keeping the gradient restores everything except the D0 bit, which never needs restoring.
